items.title: Author denies allegations she used AI to write book after novel 'dropped by agent'
items.excerpt: Author Kathryn O'Connor Mertens has issued a statement denying allegations that she used AI to write her novel Wild Horse Country, saying she has drafts, handwritten notes and research to demonstrate she wrote the book herself.

items.title: 'Keep it human': James McAvoy describes using AI for audio as 'food without calories'
items.excerpt: Speakies narrator winner James McAvoy (JD Kirk's Recall, Audible Originals) called on the audio industry to reject AI narration and 'keep it human'.

items.title: IPG partners with London Book Fair on AI training event
items.excerpt: The Independent Publishers Guild has partnered with the London Book Fair to deliver a half-day training event on the use of artificial intelligence in publishing.

history_match.title: Publishers urge US court to reject OpenAI's fair use defence in copyright case

items.title: Anthropic has started paying out its copyright settlement to authors
items.excerpt: Novelist Courtney Milan says she has already received her share of Anthropic's $1.5B settlement; the full payout should be about $3,000 per book, with part still to come early next year.

history_match.title: Wizards of the Coast shares AI copyright settlement money with D&D's authors

items.title: “헌책 6000권 사겠다”… ‘AI 학습용 의심’ 구매 문의에 출판계 촉각
items.excerpt: 서울 헌책방과 대형 서점에 신원 불명 업체의 6000권·10만 권 단위 대량 매입 문의가 잇따라, 출판계는 LLM 학습 데이터 확보용 매집을 의심하고 있다.

items.title: Fan art, mangas et IA : France et Japon face à l'avenir de la création
items.excerpt: Dans le dernier volet de son reportage au Japon, ActuaLitté compare comment éditeurs de manga français et japonais abordent fan art et IA générative dans la protection des œuvres.

items.title: “Corriger le texte d'une machine et traduire une œuvre sont deux gestes différents”
items.excerpt: Face à l'irruption de l'IA dans la traduction littéraire, Rafael Patron plaide pour passer des principes à des engagements vérifiables entre éditeurs et traducteurs.

items.title: Getbackers Voice Comic Staff Apologizes for Generative AI Use in PR Video
items.excerpt: The Getbackers voice comic team apologized for undisclosed generative AI in a promo video, saying the voice comic itself (resuming Dec 1) will not use generative AI and that Kodansha had no role.

history_match.title: Getbackers Manga Gets Comic Anime From AI Platform MangaNow Studio

items.title: AI Training is Copyright Infringement: What Publishers Need to Know about Thomson Reuters v Ross Intelligence
items.excerpt: Analysis of the Third Circuit's Ross opinion: the more an AI tool is marketed as solving research challenges, the less transformative its use of STM content becomes.

items.title: Audible Launches Audio Discovery Trailers
items.excerpt: Audible's new audio discovery 'enhanced trailers' pair audiobook clips with synopsis and character insights narrated by Audible's AI virtual voice.

history_match.title: Audible turns to AI to help users discover audiobooks

items.title: “너도 AI 썼지” 불신 팽배…AI 부정활용에 골머리 앓는 학회들
items.excerpt: 국내 학술지들이 AI 부정 활용 의심 논문을 연구윤리 위반으로 판정·철회하는 사례가 잇따르며 학계에 'AI 썼지' 불신이 번지고 있다.

items.title: À Montreuil, les artistes-auteurs font entendre leurs revendications pour l'élection présidentielle
items.excerpt: Au Salon du livre de Montreuil, les artistes-auteurs, fragilisés par l'IA, portent leurs revendications de protection en vue de la présidentielle 2027.

items.title: Australian university presses sign up to AI charter
items.excerpt: Several Australian university presses have signed the charter launched by Cambridge University Press and Bristol University Press in response to AI pressures on scholarly publishing.

history_match.title: University Presses Sign Charter Promising Integrity, Vigilance Over AI

items.title: GlobalComix's pivot to AI is just muddying the waters
items.excerpt: Comics Beat argues GlobalComix's AI-powered refresh blurs its creator-first positioning.

history_match.title: GlobalComix's AI-Powered Refresh Looks a Lot Like Its Competition

items.title: Les éditeurs belges veulent un label « sans IA » pour rassurer les lecteurs
items.excerpt: Belgian publishers are considering a 'without AI' certification label and a price adjustment for books published in Belgium to protect quality and frame AI use.

items.title: A French Publisher Shuts Its Doors to Manuscripts as AI Submissions Pile Up
items.excerpt: Independent French publisher Aux Forges de Vulcain paused manuscript submissions for four months after about 80 a week, some machine-made, overwhelmed its four staff.

items.title: IFWG and IPI Comics put their ban on AI-made work into contracts
items.excerpt: IFWG Publishing and IPI Comics wrote an AI-made-work ban into contracts and pledged to keep books out of training deals; Candlemark & Gleam makes authors certify how they wrote.

items.title: Authors have been ripped off by AI, while hypocritical publishers stay silent
items.excerpt: An author argues publishers must back writers as Anthropic profits from models trained on their books.

items.title: 한국어 책 166톤 미국 반출… AI 학습 시대, 출판 저작권의 숙제
items.excerpt: 선적 기록상 165.69톤(약 41만 권)의 한국어 책이 웅진북센→Better World Books를 거쳐 Anthropic 도서 조달 유통망으로 반출돼 스캔 후 폐기된 것으로 전해졌다.

items.title: アンソロピックに無断販売された日本の書籍、絶版が複数含まれていたと判明…ＡＩ学習で大量スキャンか
